changes.name: MatchingIslandVisualsV43
changes.source:
local world=workspace:WaitForChild("GrowIslandWorld")
local starter=world:WaitForChild("StarterIsland")

-- Visual-only matching: do NOT move or resize any land.
-- Expansion pieces keep their normal animation/position and simply use
-- the exact same material and color as the starter island.
local function matchVisuals(p)
 if not p:IsA("BasePart") then return end
 if p.Name:match("^L%d+_") or p.Name:find("Expansion") then
  p.Material=starter.Material
  p.Color=starter.Color
 end
end

local function apply()
 local directional=world:FindFirstChild("DirectionalExpansions")
 if directional then
  for _,v in ipairs(directional:GetDescendants()) do matchVisuals(v) end
 end
 for _,v in ipairs(world:GetChildren()) do matchVisuals(v) end
end

apply()
world.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(v)
 task.wait()
 matchVisuals(v)
end)
